notes.title: R3D STAR Dev Log – Big Progress & New Features!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey ducky friends![/b][/h1]

First of all, I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself properly. I'm a solo dev from Italy, and D3AD HAND is my first real attempt at making a full adventure game for Steam. 

I approached it as a learning experience, and honestly, I wasn’t sure if anyone would actually play it! Seeing people enjoy the game—even though it’s short and simple—has been incredibly rewarding.

[b]At first, I didn’t have the confidence to start with something more complex. [/b]

That’s why working on R3D STAR is such a big step for me. It’s a much bigger, more ambitious update, and I’m pouring everything I’ve learned into making it the best experience possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135554/05163d4dc6041745e19716780c7c5c0f0b39cda5.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Feature: In-Game Help Line[/b][/h2]

One thing I’ve been working on is an in-game help line—so if you get stuck, you can call Dimitri for hints! This should make the game more accessible and prevent frustration while keeping the challenge intact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135554/9097afdf243cf44fa9525c8e57b35e88bb31d6d3.png[/img]

[h2][b]Progress Update: The Second Part is Complete![/b][/h2]

The second part of R3D STAR is done and currently in testing! Playtests suggest it takes at least 2 hours to complete and lets players explore 26 new locations. That’s already much bigger than the base game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135554/facac3c260c383eca24f14d6d0e4f6a0c9840806.png[/img]

[b]A Bit About the Story[/b]

A mysterious radio message requesting help prompts Yuri and Stalin to leave the bunker and venture into the tundra, searching for the distress signal’s origin. What they find out there… well, you’ll have to play to discover! 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135554/3ad2ab49241ddb79f04120fb6170c2edd112895c.png[/img]

[h2][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h2]

Next month, I’ll be focusing on developing the final part of the game. The Game Design Document is ready, so I’ll soon start drawing the new locations. I’m excited to reveal that R3D STAR will feature multiple endings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135554/9989abdf7942878e52e613fbf5e3f3cf3d28af5c.png[/img]

[h2][b]Mixed Feelings, But Pushing Forward![/b][/h2]

I’ll be honest—it’s been exhausting. Part of me was tempted to move on to a new project, using everything I’ve learned to start fresh. But another part of me wants to make D3AD HAND the best it can be, listening to your feedback and following my heart.
[b]Thank You![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135554/d9a29a665ca7819219c8143e6ea4727bf7b0a13f.png[/img]

Your support means everything. If you enjoyed the game, please leave a review and share it with your friends—it helps a solo dev like me more than you know!

[h3]Thanks for sticking with me on this journey. R3D STAR is coming soon! 🚀[/h3]

[previewyoutube=_h2hoy0Vy8g;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: R3D STAR - February update

Hi Ducky friends,

Please bear with me while I'm working on R3D STAR! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135554/8d99a51a06d19e36d803accbc549428c87839a3d.png[/img]

Great news! [b]Part 2 of R3D STAR is about 75% done[/b], and it's already shaping up to be much longer than[b] D3AD HAND![/b] Instead of creating a new game, I’m fully committed to expanding and improving the D3AD HAND experience for all of you who enjoyed it and wanted more.

notes.title: R3D STAR: November Update
notes.content:
Hi! I'm finalising the story and the characters for R3D STAR DLC.
I have already integrate the DLC in the main menù of the game, so all you will have to do to play the new episode is to select R3D STAR from the title! 

I want to thank everybody for the support and the feedback. I'll keep all of your comments in mind for this new bit. 

R3D STAR will have:

- Less first person puzzles and more classic adventure game puzzles
- New music and new characters (see illustrations)
- Stalin as a playable character.
- More sci-fiction elements 

Here you can see the sketches for the new characters of R3D STAR before being transformed into pixel art.
